title: Holi Photoshoot Outfit Ideas: Colours That Pop for 2027
excerpt: Holi photoshoot outfit ideas: which base colours make gulal pop, prints vs solids, and how to plan clean before shots and colourful after shots.
body:
For a Holi photoshoot, wear white, off-white or a soft pastel so the gulal stands out, and pick solid colours or small prints rather than busy patterns. Plan a clean "before" look and a colourful "after" look, and choose a cotton outfit with some movement so twirls and colour throws look alive on camera.

This guide is for anyone planning Holi photos in late March 2027 (check your local calendar), whether a styled shoot with a photographer, couple photos or a group session with friends. A clean [off-white embroidered cotton kurta set](/products/off-white-embroidered-cotton-flex-kurta-pant-organza-dupatta-set/) gives you the best canvas.

*By the Bahe Kurtiz styling team, Jaipur. Our block prints are hand printed by karigars, and our pieces are made in our own Jaipur unit.*

## Which outfit colours make Holi colours pop in photos?

Contrast is the secret. Gulal shows best against a light, plain background, which is why white has always been the Holi photo favourite. Off-white looks a touch softer and warmer on camera, especially in natural light.

Pastels are the next best option. Mint, sky blue and blush let pink, yellow and orange stand out while giving the photo a colour story of its own. Darker colours such as navy and black can look dramatic, but the powder shows unevenly and mid tones disappear.

| Outfit base colour | Gulal that pops most | Mood in photos | Watch out for |
|---|---|---|---|
| White or off-white | Every colour | Classic, bright | Test opacity when wet |
| Mint or sage | Pink, yellow, orange | Fresh, spring | Green gulal blends in |
| Sky blue | Pink, yellow, red | Airy, soft | Blue gulal blends in |
| Navy or black | Yellow, pink, white | Dramatic | Powder looks patchy |

## Should you wear prints or solid colours for a Holi shoot?

Solids and small prints photograph best once colour is thrown, because the gulal becomes the pattern. Large, busy prints compete with the powder and can make photos look cluttered.

That said, a soft print works well for your "before" photos and for detail shots. A blue and white floral, like the [white and blue floral cotton halter peplum co-ord](/products/white-blue-floral-cotton-halter-peplum-top-with-palazzo-co-ord-set/) at $35, keeps a light base while adding interest.

> **From our Jaipur studio:** Hand embroidery adds texture that a camera picks up beautifully, especially at the neckline in close-ups. Block print cotton has a soft, slightly matte surface, so it does not glare under bright sun. For twirl shots, palazzos and flared kurtas give you movement, while a light dupatta held up behind you makes a lovely frame for a colour throw.

## How do you plan before and after Holi photos?

The best Holi galleries tell a story: clean and festive first, then a burst of colour, then the happy, messy end. Plan for all three.

Start with your clean look, styled with jewellery and a dupatta, and take portraits, couple shots and detail photos first. Then move into colour play, beginning with light dustings before full throws. Finish with candid group photos and laughter shots.

If you want two very different looks, change outfits between stages. Shoot "before" in your embroidered set, then switch to a simple cotton tunic for the colour.

Bring these to the shoot:

- A spare outfit for the colour stage
- Hair ties, pins and a small mirror
- Wipes and a towel for quick touch-ups
- A plastic cover or pouch for phones and lenses
- A bag for wet clothes

## Which outfits work best for a Holi photoshoot?

The classic choice for portraits and colour throws. The organza dupatta catches light and makes a good prop for movement shots.

The [mint green hand block print cotton kurta pant dupatta set with hand work yoke](/products/mint-green-hand-block-print-cotton-kurta-pant-dupatta-set-with-hand-work-yoke/) at $48 is ideal for a family or couple shoot. Mint photographs fresh and spring-like.

### Matching group palette

For friends or family groups, agree a palette rather than identical outfits: whites with one pastel accent each, for example. It looks planned without feeling like a uniform.

## When is the best time of day for Holi photos?

Soft morning light or late afternoon light is kinder than harsh midday sun, and coloured powder glows when it is backlit. If you can, place the sun behind your subjects for throw shots, and use a plain wall, field or trees as your background so the colour stays the hero.

Always ask before you throw colour at people who are not part of your shoot.

## Frequently asked questions

**What colour should I wear for a Holi photoshoot?**
White or off-white gives the strongest contrast. Pastels like mint and sky blue are a softer alternative with more personality.

**Are prints or solids better for Holi photos?**
Solids and small prints photograph best once colour is thrown. Save bolder prints for your clean "before" shots.

**How do I protect my camera at a Holi shoot?**
Use a plastic cover or pouch, keep a lens cloth handy and step back from heavy throws. Wipe gear off as soon as you finish.

**Should I change outfits during a Holi shoot?**
If you want both clean and colourful looks, yes. Shoot the embroidered outfit first, then change into a simple cotton piece for colour.
